items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: My brother used to pick up tickets at the door, Charlie.

ctx.x: Yeah, I knew he was a proud fighter. This is, this is on the, the upper floor? Oh, yeah, on the upper floor.
Yeah, yeah. Yeah, yeah. I had a gym in the back. My brother used to pick up tickets at the door, Charlie. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Oh, where did, where did they have like, they had a dance hall? They had a huge dance hall. Dance hall was downstairs.
